 Santos Laguna 2 – 0 Pumas UNAM Aguirre 6' (P) Pardo 80' (P) da Silva 2' FULL TIME Goals and highlights from Santos 2-0 Pumas in Liga MX
 Santos secures its sixth consecutive victory, earning a spot in the *liguilla* (playoffs); the *Laguneros* played very well, while Pumas fell short.
 Coverage by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma Updated October 22, 2026, 1:37 am ET ADVERTISEMENT
 FULL TIME Last update 1:37 AM ET 90+7' Oct 22 1:17 AM ET an hour ago The match ends.
 The match concludes, and Santos—the team from the Laguna region—secures another three points in this Matchday 13 of Liga MX, marking their sixth victory of the tournament.
 See you soon! Thank you for joining us once again. Stay tuned to VAVEL for the best coverage of your favorite teams.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 Key moments
 1:17 AM ET 90+7' The match ends. 
 12:59 AM ET 80' Goal by Franco Pardo · 2-0 
 12:23 AM ET 46' The second half begins 
 11:51 PM ET 36' Half-time 
 11:21 PM ET 6' Goal by Eduardo Aguirre · 1-0 
 11:18 PM ET 2' Red card 
 11:15 PM ET 1' The match begins 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 90+4' Oct 22 1:14 AM ET an hour ago Both teams continue to give their all at this stage of the match, setting us up for a thrilling conclusion; hopefully, we’ll see one last goal and some great plays from both sides as the game draws to a close.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 90' Oct 22 1:11 AM ET an hour ago Seven more minutes are added; given all the moments where time was lost, the referee decided to include some extra stoppage time. This sets the stage for a nail-biting finish for both teams—let’s hope they can make the most of it.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 86' Oct 22 1:06 AM ET an hour ago There are only four minutes left in the match, and both teams are still looking for one more opportunity; however, fouls remain a constant, and substitutions are being made at this stage to ensure a strong finish.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 82' Oct 22 1:02 AM ET an hour ago There are less than ten minutes left in the match, and the home side is looking to add to their tally; following the penalty, they seem even more motivated. Hopefully, we’ll see another goal-scoring opportunity, and both teams will give their all to ensure a thrilling finish.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 80' Oct 22 12:59 AM ET an hour ago Santos' GOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAL
 Santos has added another goal; the referee awarded a penalty in their favor, and in the 80th minute, Franco Pardo converted it—striking the ball with his right foot into the center of the goal—to bring the score to 2–0.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 78' Oct 22 12:57 AM ET an hour ago We’ve reached the 78th minute; a moment ago, Felipe Sánchez tried a header from the center of the box but missed. However, a handball has been called, and Santos has been awarded a penalty—they have a great opportunity to add another goal.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 74' Oct 22 12:54 AM ET an hour ago We’ve passed the seventy-minute mark, and both teams are still giving their all in these final stages of the match; however, play has become quite congested, and substitutions are still being made as both sides look to secure a result.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 70' Oct 22 12:49 AM ET an hour ago There are only twenty minutes left in this match, and both teams continue to give their all; however, neither side has managed to create a goal-scoring opportunity, as play is heavily congested in the midfield, making it difficult for them to pose any real threat.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 66' Oct 22 12:44 AM ET an hour ago The team from the lagoon continues to seek further opportunities to secure their lead; just a moment ago, Facundo Cáseres attempted a left-footed shot from outside the box following a corner kick, but he missed.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 62' Oct 22 12:40 AM ET 2 hours ago We’ve passed the 60th minute of the match, and both teams are still pushing forward, though the game has stalled a bit; there are frequent fouls from both sides, and scoring opportunities have been very scarce. A moment ago, Villada missed a clear-cut chance from very close to the goal.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 58' Oct 22 12:36 AM ET 2 hours ago We are nearing the 60th minute of the match, and both teams are still searching for a clear opportunity to add more goals. For now, the home side remains ahead, on track to secure their sixth consecutive victory.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 54' Oct 22 12:32 AM ET 2 hours ago The match remains very intense, and both teams continue to put together some excellent plays. A moment ago, Pumas made a substitution: Víctor Arteaga has entered the pitch, replacing Adalberto Carrasquilla. The *Universitarios* are pushing for a goal.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 50' Oct 22 12:28 AM ET 2 hours ago The opening minutes of the second half have been quite rough; both teams are doing their best to create a good scoring opportunity—hopefully, we’ll see more goal-scoring chances as the match progresses.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 46' Oct 22 12:23 AM ET 2 hours ago The second half begins
 The ball is back in play for the next 45 minutes of the match between Santos and Pumas. Significant substitutions have already been made; hopefully, we’ll see a better contest, more goals, and one of these teams emerging victorious from this exciting encounter.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 45+7' Oct 22 12:06 AM ET 2 hours ago The first half ends
 The first half of the match has come to a close, with both teams giving it their all. It was a tightly contested affair, but Santos managed to open the scoring. We head into the break with a 1-0 scoreline—it’s been a fantastic match so far!
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 45+4' Oct 22 12:04 AM ET 2 hours ago The home side continues to push for one more chance during stoppage time; just a moment ago, Ezequiel Bullaude tried his luck with a header from the center of the box that went high and to the left—the *Laguneros* are hungry for more goals.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 45' 11:59 PM ET 2 hours ago Seven minutes are added; the referee decided to grant some extra stoppage time following the events that took place, as the initial allotted time had run out—and here are the highlights from those final minutes of the first half.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 40' 11:59 PM ET 2 hours ago There are only five minutes left in the first half, yet fouls remain very frequent; both teams are still looking for a good opportunity—a chance to gain the lead—so they can go all out in the second half.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 36' 11:51 PM ET 2 hours ago There is less than ten minutes left until the end of the first half; a moment ago, Fran Villalba attempted a through ball, but Diego González was in an offside position—both teams are giving it their all.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 32' 11:48 PM ET 2 hours ago We’ve passed the first thirty minutes of the match, and Pumas are still looking for a good opportunity to level the score. The match remains very intense—we’ll likely see more goals in the coming minutes.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 28' 11:43 PM ET 3 hours ago We are nearing the thirty-minute mark of the match; a moment ago, César Huerta attempted a left-footed shot from the left side of the penalty area, but he missed. At the moment, the match is paused due to an injury to Eduardo Aguirre.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 24' 11:38 PM ET 3 hours ago Pumas continues to search for an equalizer; a moment ago, Pedro Vite tried his luck with a left-footed shot from outside the box, but he missed. Hopefully, we’ll see more goals—Santos has dropped back a bit and seems content with the current situation.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 20' 11:34 PM ET 3 hours ago We’ve reached the 20th minute of the match; it’s been very intense so far, with both teams pushing to get another goal. Play is currently stopped due to an injury to Efraín Orona, and a substitution is about to be made.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 16' 11:31 PM ET 3 hours ago Both teams continue to look for another opportunity to score; a moment ago, Tahiel Jiménez attempted a header from the center of the box, but it went well over the bar. Both teams are playing very well.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 12' 11:26 PM ET 3 hours ago Pumas is looking for an opportunity; a moment ago, Uriel Antuna attempted a shot with his right foot from the right side of the penalty area, but he missed. Hopefully, both teams will gradually push for more goals.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 8' 11:22 PM ET 3 hours ago Since scoring their goal, Santos has looked very motivated; with an extra man on the pitch, they continue to be clearly superior. Hopefully, we’ll see more goal-scoring opportunities in this match, and Pumas will manage to recover from that psychological blow—both teams are after all three points.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 6' 11:21 PM ET 3 hours ago Santos' GOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAL
 After a long wait, in the 6th minute, Eduardo Aguirre converted a penalty—striking the ball with his right foot into the right side of the goal—to put the home side ahead. We are in for a very intense match.
 ¡Gol de vestidor para los Guerreros! 🔥

 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 2' 11:18 PM ET 3 hours ago In the opening minutes of the match, Nathan Silva is sent off for a harsh foul inside the box, resulting in a penalty for Santos. Let’s hope this penalty leads to a goal, allowing the home side to take an early lead.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 1' 11:15 PM ET 3 hours ago The match begins
 The encounter is underway; the ball is in play, and the home side has kicked off, taking possession in the opening moments. Both teams are hungry for victory and eager to score, and they will give their all to secure an early advantage.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 11:15 PM ET 3 hours ago Stay tuned
 Everything is nearly ready at the stadium for our coverage on VAVEL.com. Follow every development on the pitch and the final result of this Matchday 10 Liga MX encounter to see who secures another three points.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 11:14 PM ET 3 hours ago Pumas' starting XI
 This is the starting eleven that the Pumas team has fielded for this match on matchday 10; the hope is that this lineup works in their favor, that it proves to be a highly intense game, and that they give their absolute best to secure a win and earn the points at stake.

 11:11 PM ET 3 hours ago Checking out the pitch
 The players are nearly ready to train ahead of the match and are getting a feel for the pitch; both teams will give their all to win this Matchday 10 encounter in Liga MX, aiming to start this round on the right foot and secure a victory.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 11:10 PM ET 3 hours ago Fans are already arriving
 Fans are gathering for this major clash in Matchday 10 of Liga MX, where both teams will give their all in pursuit of a victory. The match is just moments away, and both sides are set to put forth their best effort to secure a result.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 11:08 PM ET 3 hours ago Pumas Are Arriving at the Stadium
 The Pumas players are arriving at the stadium; they’ll be giving it their all to secure a win in this Matchday 10 game, thereby solidifying their victory and, in doing so, aiming to improve their record, build momentum, and continue their strong run in this competition
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 11:08 PM ET 3 hours ago Santos is arriving at the stadium
 The Santos players are arriving at the stadium; they’ll be giving it their all to secure a victory in this Matchday 10 game, thereby solidifying their win and, in doing so, aiming to improve their record, build momentum, and continue performing well in this competition
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 11:07 PM ET 3 hours ago Welcome, VAVEL readers!
 We’re back! We’re getting ready to bring you all the action from the Santos vs. Pumas match in Liga MX. Join us as we follow the developments and highlights of this great matchup, which will take this thrilling competition into Matchday 10.
